描述_ZN: The Reclining Travels album, Ming Dynasty, painted by Shen Zhou, on paper, in color, with seventeen openings, each 27.8 cm long and 37.3 cm wide. The album is painted with small scenes of landscapes, flowers and birds, such as imitation Ni landscape, apricot blossoms, autumn anemones, autumn willows singing cicadas, scattered grazing on a flat slope, gardenia flowers, autumn landscape, hibiscus, loquat, autumn mountain reading, pomegranate, chickens, autumn river fishing boats, vegetable flowers, rivers and mountains sitting and talking, imitation rice landscape, and snow river fisherman.　　　According to the artist's inscription at the end, it is clear that the name of the scroll "Reclining Tour" comes from the allusion to the four walls of Song Zong Bing's apartment in the Southern Dynasty, where he hung landscapes as a reclining tour. However, unlike the hanging scrolls, the album can also be read while lying on one's back. This shows the artist's original intention and interest in life.　　The artist writes "Reclining" at the beginning of the scroll and inserts the seal of "Shen Qinan" in vermilion.
